Scacelith coach voice
=====================

This folder holds the text-to-speech model the coach speaks with: Supertonic 3 by Supertone Inc.,
in the INT8 ONNX conversion published by the sherpa-onnx project
(sherpa-onnx-supertonic-3-tts-int8-2026-05-11). Scacelith reads these files at run time; they are
not part of the Scacelith program and are not covered by its GPL-3.0 licence.

The model is licensed under the BigScience Open RAIL-M licence, in
Supertonic-3-OpenRAIL-M.txt. Its Attachment A lists use restrictions that apply to anyone using
or redistributing the model; among them, content it generates must be disclosed as machine
generated (restriction e) and must not be used to impersonate anyone (restriction g). The coach
is a robot character and its voice is synthetic.

Deleting this folder is harmless: the coach then shows its lines as subtitles only.
